items.title: Runtime lifecycle: define settled-turn boundaries and skill resource cleanup contracts
items.summary:
## Findings and motivation

Pi distinguishes an agent-loop end from final settlement after automatic retries, recovery, compaction, or queued continuation. `agent_before_settle` is actionable and may request continuation; `agent_settled` is final and notification-only.

Pi also documents extension lifecycle ownership: registration factories must not start long-lived processes/watchers/timers; resources begin at session start or on demand and close in an idempotent session-shutdown handler.
